answer_1.quote: The MNMT task, which was formally introduced in the WMT 2016 Shared Task , aims to translate the source sentence into the target sentence by incorporating additional modalities, most commonly in the form of visual information.

answer_2.quote: Existing automatic evaluation methods for MNMT can be broadly divided into three categories: (1) methods for evaluating the text translation quality of MNMT models; (2) methods for evaluating the contribution of visual information to the performance of MNMT models; and (3) methods for evaluating the effectiveness of fusing the information from the visual and textual modalities.

answer_4.quote: Human evaluation has been used to complement automatic evaluation metrics for evaluating MNMT outputs that involve fluency and adequacy assessment and quality estimation.
